name: 语义密度分析
description: Measures information density uniformity across content.
useCase: Detecting AI text through uniform information density
mechanism: Segments content into columns and measures entropy in each. AI text distributes information too evenly, while human writing has natural density variations.
source: Dugan et al. (2023) - Real or Fake Text? Investigating Human Ability to Detect Boundaries
parameters: Window size: adaptive, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropy, CV, correlation
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated text
- Language-agnostic statistical approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger false positives
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies across writing styles

references.title: Dugan et al. (2023) - Real or Fake Text? Investigating Human Ability to Detect Boundaries
Mitchell, E. et al. (2023). DetectGPT: Zero-Shot Machine-Generated Text Detection using Probability Curvature. ICML.
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. arXiv.
